en.title: Val Chmerkovskiy Apologizes to Carrie Ann Inaba for Oscars Slap Reference
en.summary: Dancing With the Stars pro Val Chmerkovskiy has issued a public apology to judge Carrie Ann Inaba following a social media post that drew comparisons to the Will Smith Oscars incident. The dancer acknowledged his remark was "careless" and vowed to do better.
en.body:
The ballroom floor at **Dancing With the Stars** can be as fraught with tension as any dramatic television series, and sometimes the drama spills off the dance floor. **Val Chmerkovskiy**, a long-time professional dancer on the show, recently found himself in hot water for a social media post that many interpreted as a reference to **Will Smith**'s infamous slap at the 2022 Academy Awards. Chmerkovskiy's post read, "You almost saw Fresh Prince enter the ballroom last night," a clear nod to Smith's role as the Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. This comment, made in the context of a heated competition, did not sit well with everyone, particularly with **Carrie Ann Inaba**, one of the show's main judges.

In the aftermath, **Chmerkovskiy** recognized the insensitivity of his remark and extended a direct apology to **Inaba** and anyone else he may have offended. The incident underscores the fine line between edgy humor and offensive commentary, especially when drawing parallels to real-world controversies. For fans of **DWTS**, such moments can be jarring, pulling them away from the glitz and glamour of the competition and into the messier realities of public discourse. The reference, whether intended or not, touched a nerve, reminding viewers of a highly publicized and controversial event.

> "Carrie Ann, and everyone I hurt with my careless post. I will do better." — **Val Chmerkovskiy**

## The Fan Reaction and Stakes

The online reaction to **Chmerkovskiy**'s post and subsequent apology has been mixed, as is often the case with social media controversies. While some fans have accepted his apology and acknowledged the accidental nature of the offense, others have been more critical, suggesting that such references are inappropriate, especially within the family-friendly atmosphere that **DWTS** often strives to maintain. For **Inaba**, who has been a constant presence on the judging panel for years, navigating these public comments is part of the job, but it also highlights the scrutiny she and her fellow judges face. The stakes for **Chmerkovskiy** and his celebrity partner are always high, with each week bringing the possibility of elimination. A controversy like this, however minor it may seem to outsiders, can create an uncomfortable dynamic in the rehearsal room and affect the judges' perception, potentially influencing scores and audience votes.

## What's Next

While the immediate controversy appears to have been addressed with **Chmerkovskiy**'s apology, the incident serves as a reminder of the power of social media and the importance of careful communication. **Dancing With the Stars** continues its season with new routines and challenges each week. Viewers will be watching to see if this moment impacts the relationships between the cast and judges and how **Chmerkovskiy** and his partner perform in the coming episodes.

content_raw: The dancer made a post writing, “You almost saw Fresh Prince enter the ballroom last night," which prompted the judge to respond with her own social post that read, "So this is what we are doing now?"
